question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Jaded
solution:
The correct answer is **"Renewed"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"jaded"** refers to the feeling of being bored, fatigued, or lacking enthusiasm, typically after having had too much of something. (लगातार लंबे समय तक एक ही काम करने से थका और ऊबा हुआ; थका-माँदा; थककर चूर)

 
 
• **For Example -** *After working the same job for ten years, she felt **jaded**__ and longed for a new challenge.*
 
 
 
• **"Renewed,"** on the other hand, refers to gaining fresh life, strength, or vitality after a period of depletion or fatigue. ((किसी काम को) फिर से शुरू करना)
 __
 
• **For Example -** *After a week-long vacation on the beach, he returned to work feeling refreshed and **renewed**__.*
 
 
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word **"Jaded"** is **"Renewed."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Impressed: **Feeling admiration and respect toward something or someone due to perceived high quality, skill, or value. (कथित उच्च गुणवत्ता, कौशल या मूल्य के कारण किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति के प्रति प्रशंसा और सम्मान महसूस करना)
 
• **Settled:** In a state of stability or permanence, or in the context of an argument or an account, concluded or agreed upon. (स्थिरता या स्थायित्व की स्थिति में, या किसी तर्क या खाते के संदर्भ में, निष्कर्ष निकाला गया या सहमति व्यक्त की गई)
 
• **Unflinching: **Not showing fear or hesitance in the face of danger or challenge; maintaining a steady and determined attitude. (खतरे या चुनौती के सामने डर या झिझक नहीं दिखाना; एक स्थिर और दृढ़ रवैया बनाए रखना)
